_doc: Trust policy for Beacon's approval gate. First-match-wins; default_action applies when no rule matches. Edit this file to add carve-outs as Larry builds confidence in specific dispatch shapes. Reloaded on every evaluate() call so changes take effect without restart. See scripts/trust_policy.py for the evaluator and schema.

_rule_fields.source: agent/system that initiated the task. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.target: agent receiving the dispatch. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.task_type: label on the task envelope. "*" or omitted matches any.
_rule_fields.repos: glob list against task.target_repo. [] matches any.
_rule_fields.file_patterns: glob list against task.changed_files. [] matches any.

_example_rules_disabled._note: Pulse-flagged doc-only changes in agent-core auto-approve. Uncomment to enable.
